title: Jolly Light Dutch Ciabatta Toast
description: A sour, light, and comforting Dutch dish featuring ciabatta, perfect for a snack or light meal, and friendly to dairy-free diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the ciabatta loaf into 1-inch thick slices.
In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Brush the mixture onto each slice of ciabatta.
Place the slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dot the top of each slice with dairy-free butter.
Sprinkle sliced almonds over the butter.
Bake the ciabatta slices in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Remove the ciabatta from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the Jolly Light Dutch Ciabatta Toast warm and enjoy.
